question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-scoped web/tool credential override surface, and should that surface live under `agents.list[].tools.web`, plugin-owned per-agent config, or a broader unified credential model?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent shape changes credential isolation, SecretRef activation, plugin ownership, and config compatibility, so automation cannot safely choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design Unified Credential Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide one agent-scoped credential model that covers web tools, plugin-owned webSearch config, SecretRefs, validation, reload, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Plugin Config Design
options.body: Treat this request as a narrower slice of the open generic per-agent plugin-config issue and require that design to explicitly cover web-search credentials.

options.title: Decline Agent-Scoped Tool Credentials
options.body: Document separate gateways, SecretRefs, or external isolation as the supported boundary for different web-search billing/accounts and close after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design Unified Credential Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide one agent-scoped credential model that covers web tools, plugin-owned webSearch config, SecretRefs, validation, reload, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans the current config schema, secrets runtime, and security-sensitive credential boundary where recent history and CODEOWNERS context point most strongly to steipete.
